children.name: Blandfordia ×flammea-elegans W.G.Sm.
children.description: An artificial horticultural hybrid in the family Blandfordiaceae, with hybrid formula Blandfordia cunninghamii x B. grandiflora. A 19th-century garden hybrid of the Australian Christmas bells raised by Edward George Henderson & Son and figured in 1874. Like its Blandfordia parents (tufted rhizomatous perennial herbs from eastern Australia with narrow linear leaves), it bears large, drooping, tubular red-and-yellow flowers.

children.name: Blandfordia cunninghamii Lindl.
children.description: Blandfordia cunninghamii is one of four species of flowering plant commonly known as Christmas bells.

children.name: Blandfordia flammea Lindl., 1849
children.description: Blandfordia grandiflora, commonly known as Christmas bells, is a flowering plant endemic to eastern Australia. It is a tufted perennial herb with narrow, channelled, linear leaves and between two and twenty large, drooping, bell-shaped flowers.
